scenario.intent: Generate a woodworking plan equivalent to a floating canvas frame with a rabbeted back edge and thin strainer rails seated on the rabbet ledge.
builder_goals: support a 16 x 20 inch stretched canvas with an even floating reveal
mill a rabbet into the inside back edge before assembly
seat thinner strainer rails on the rabbet ledge
include cut list, staged build steps, and clear milling/assembly visuals

scenario.intent: Generate a simple rectangular outdoor planter box with slatted sides, a bottom panel, drainage holes, and beginner-friendly build steps.
builder_goals: use common cedar fence picket or 1x stock
include drainage holes and outdoor material notes
show cut layout, drill layout, and staged side assembly

scenario.intent: Generate a compact desktop bookshelf with two side panels, top and bottom shelves, and adjustable vertical dividers.
builder_goals: validate panel overlap and clear book openings
show staged assembly with dividers added after the box is square

scenario.intent: Generate a folding sawhorse plan with paired legs, a top beam, hinge hardware, spreader restraint, and conservative load-bearing warnings.
builder_goals: include hinge and spreader hardware layout
validate leg angles, fastener clearances, and load-bearing caution
show folding mechanism as an assembly and review concern
